info.name: Sanad Admin — Finance
info.description: Shared platform fee/tax configuration. Use a normal SuperAdmin or SupportAdmin JWT for the Finance folder. The legacy subscription-tax adapter remains SuperAdmin-only. These requests are manual configuration examples; do not run against production or shared data without owner authorization.

item.name: Shared Finance charge rules (SuperAdmin or SupportAdmin)
Create platform charge rule

request.description: FinanceOperationalAdmin (SuperAdmin/SupportAdmin). Creates a versioned platform-charge rule and returns 201 with the new rule GUID (not 200). Invalid input 400 Finance.Charges.Invalid; version conflicts 409.

item.description: Returns 201 with the new rule UUID. Percentages are independent and apply to the payment base; no absent-config default exists. Version must exceed the latest stored Finance version. Manual/destructive configuration request; use only on an owner-authorized disposable target.

item.name: Get current platform charge rule

request.description: FinanceOperationalAdmin. Returns 200 with the active PlatformChargeRuleResponse, or 204 with no body before the first rule exists (never JSON null).

item.description: Returns 200 with the effective active rule, or 204 with no body when no effective rule exists. SuperAdmin and SupportAdmin only.

item.name: Get platform charge rule history

request.description: FinanceOperationalAdmin. Returns 200 with the bare array of PlatformChargeRuleResponse rows ordered by descending version.

item.description: Returns 200 with all shared rules ordered by descending version. Historical rules and transaction snapshots are preserved. SuperAdmin and SupportAdmin only.

item.name: Caregiver payout policy (SuperAdmin or FinanceAdmin)
item.description: Caregiver payout timing policy under /api/v1/admin/finance/caregiver-payout-policies. Requires the PayoutOperationalAdmin policy (SuperAdmin or FinanceAdmin); SupportAdmin and ContentAdmin are denied. No payout fee is configured here: entitlement is always the booking snapshot BaseCaregiverFee. Each create is a new policy version; optional bilingual descriptions are surfaced to caregivers by GET /api/v1/caregiver/payment-policy.

item.name: Create caregiver payout policy

body.raw:
{
  "payoutDelayHours": 72,
  "version": 1,
  "effectiveOnUtc": "2026-10-08T00:00:00Z",
  "descriptionArabic": "يُدفع بعد 72 ساعة من إتمام الحجز وسداده",
  "descriptionEnglish": "Payout is released 72 hours after the booking is completed and paid."
}

item.description: Returns 201 with the new policy UUID. payoutDelayHours must be zero or more; version must exceed the latest stored payout policy version. descriptionArabic/descriptionEnglish are optional (trimmed, max 4000 chars each, blank → null) and are what caregivers read back from GET /api/v1/caregiver/payment-policy; policies without them surface null descriptions. Manual/destructive configuration request; use only on an owner-authorized disposable target.

item.name: Get current caregiver payout policy
item.description: Returns 200 with the effective payout policy (including descriptionArabic/descriptionEnglish when authored), or JSON null when no effective policy exists. SuperAdmin and FinanceAdmin only.

item.name: Get caregiver payout policy history
item.description: Returns 200 with all payout policies ordered by descending version. SuperAdmin and FinanceAdmin only.

item.name: Legacy subscription-tax adapter (SuperAdmin only)
item.description: Compatibility routes under /api/v1/admin/subscriptions/tax-rules. They retain the existing SuperAdmin-only SubscriptionPlanAdmin policy. Use the shared Finance folder for new fee/tax configuration.

item.name: Legacy create subscription tax rule
item.description: Compatibility adapter. Shared Finance configuration must already exist; the current platform-fee rate is carried forward. SuperAdmin only.

item.name: Legacy current subscription tax rule
item.description: Compatibility read. SuperAdmin only; shared records include the effective platform-fee fields.

item.name: Legacy subscription tax rule history
item.description: Compatibility read. SuperAdmin only; shared history is returned alongside preserved legacy tax records.

item.name: Caregiver payouts (SuperAdmin or FinanceAdmin)
item.description: Caregiver payout records and manual transfer recording under /api/v1/admin/caregiver-payouts. Requires the PayoutOperationalAdmin policy (SuperAdmin or FinanceAdmin). The eligible-bookings selector is a read-only list of bookings currently eligible for recording. Recording validates Completed+Paid eligibility, effective policy timing, saved payout account, and duplicate payment. Manual fixture only; never replay a record against shared data.

request.description: PayoutOperationalAdmin (SuperAdmin/FinanceAdmin). Read-only selector (GET /api/v1/admin/caregiver-payouts/eligible-bookings) of bookings eligible for a manual payout record right now: completed and paid with both timestamps, effective payout delay elapsed, caregiver payout account Verified, and no Paid payout. A Failed payout does not exclude the booking, so it reappears for retry. Optional caregiverId filter; page >= 1 and pageSize clamped 1-100; rows ordered oldest eligible first. No effective policy returns 400 Finance.PayoutPolicy.Missing. Returns only booking/caregiver identity, safe display names, timestamps, and the caregiver fee amount/currency; never bank or IBAN data. Authored example, not runtime evidence.

item.name: List caregiver payouts
item.description: Returns 200 with payouts ordered by recording time descending. Response status is Paid or Failed. SuperAdmin and FinanceAdmin only.

item.name: Get caregiver payout
item.description: Returns 200 with one payout including masked bank details, or 404 Caregivers.Payouts.NotFound.

item.name: Record caregiver payout transfer
item.description: Returns 201 with the paid payout. Requires an eligible Completed+Paid booking, effective payout policy, saved payout account, and no existing paid payout. Manual fixture only.

item.name: Mark caregiver payout failed
item.description: Moves a paid payout to Failed with actor and time. Only paid payouts can be marked; otherwise 409.

item.name: Caregiver payout accounts (SuperAdmin or FinanceAdmin)
item.description: Payout-account review queue under /api/v1/admin/caregiver-payout-accounts. Status values are Pending, Verified, Rejected, and Revoked. Requires the PayoutOperationalAdmin policy. Ownership is verified through an external source; the full IBAN is revealed only by the dedicated audited reveal request. Manual fixture only.

item.name: List payout accounts
item.description: Returns 200 with masked IBANs only, pending first. SuperAdmin and FinanceAdmin only.

item.name: Get payout account
item.description: Returns 200 with masked bank details and verification evidence, or 404.

item.name: List payout account reviews
item.description: Returns 200 with the append-only decision history, newest first. Reveal events are included; no IBAN content.

item.name: Approve payout account
item.description: Owner: approve only after an external source confirms the exact account belongs to the caregiver. Stale revisions return 409. Manual fixture only.

item.name: Reject payout account
item.description: Reason of 1-500 characters is required. Only pending accounts can be rejected.

item.name: Revoke payout account
item.description: Direct revocation of a verified account. Reason of 1-500 characters is required.

item.name: Reveal payout account IBAN
item.description: The only operation returning the full IBAN. No-store response; every reveal is audited. Manual fixture only; never replay against shared data.

item.name: Get platform controls
item.description: SuperAdmin only (401 unauthenticated, 403 any other role). Returns version, state (1 Operational, 2 Maintenance), the bilingual maintenance message, the Card/Wallet switches, and updatedOnUtc. 503 Platform.ControlStateUnavailable when the control record cannot be read; there is no default Operational fallback.

item.name: Update platform controls

body.raw:
{
  "expectedVersion": 1,
  "state": 2,
  "cardEnabled": false,
  "walletEnabled": true,
  "maintenanceMessageArabic": "الصيانة الدورية",
  "maintenanceMessageEnglish": "Scheduled maintenance",
  "internalReason": "Paymob maintenance window"
}

item.description: Full replacement of the editable values; every field is supplied explicitly and an omitted method switch is disabled. Send the version read from the previous request as expectedVersion. 400 Platform.Control.Invalid (invalid value or message over 500 characters), 409 Platform.ControlVersionConflict (stale version, current state preserved), 503 Platform.ControlStateUnavailable. This example switches the platform into Maintenance and disables Card: it changes live availability, so run it only on an owner-authorized target and restore the previous state afterwards. internalReason is stored in the audit history only and is never returned publicly.
